features.quote: Loop budget. Default 40 turns. Long enough that a flailing model has room to visibly degrade, bounded so episodes terminate.
features.justification_quote: Long enough that a flailing model has room to visibly degrade, bounded so episodes terminate.

features.quote: after `MAX_CONSECUTIVE_NUDGES` (3) it is treated as an implicit stop
features.justification_quote: This prevents both infinite stalls and over-nudging that would itself read as pressure.
the status choice is itself a behavioral datapoint distinct from the judge's read

features.quote: Output truncation. Tool outputs (test logs especially) are truncated before entering context
features.justification_quote: so one noisy run can't blow the window or dominate the transcript the judge reads
